name: Bow
author: RaintDM
entries: Bow Save DC: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Dexterity modifier

rows: Elemental Coatings, Dragonpiercer, Gauge Upgrade I
Acid Coating, Cold Coating, Fire Coating, Lightning Coating
Blast Coating (Cost: 1 Charge), Poison Coating (Cost: 2 Charges), Paralysis Coating (Cost: 2 Charges), Sleep Coating (Cost: 2 Charges), Power Coating Upgrade I
Elemental Coatings Upgrade I, True Dragonpiercer, Gauge Upgrade III

customFeatures.name: Mastery (Slow)
customFeatures.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

customFeatures.name: Charging Sidestep
customFeatures.description: As a Bonus Action, you can leap up to 15 feet in any direction and generate 1 Coating Charge. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. If you make a ranged weapon attack with this bow immediately after using this Bonus Action, the attack deals an extra 1d4 piercing damage on a hit.

customFeatures.name: Coating Charges
customFeatures.description: The bow's magical quiver generates its own specialized coatings. It holds a maximum of 5 Coating Charges, regaining all expended charges when you finish a Short or Long Rest. Any unspent charges safely dissipate if you haven't made an attack with this weapon for 1 minute. The gauge resets to 0 after a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, you can generate 2 Coating Charges. When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend 1 charge to instantly apply a coating to the arrow.

customFeatures.name: Power Coating
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d6 Piercing damage.

customFeatures.name: Close Range Coating
customFeatures.description: You can use this coating before you make the attack roll. You do not suffer Disadvantage for making this ranged attack while a hostile creature is within 5 feet of you.

customFeatures.name: Elemental Coatings
customFeatures.description: Your quiver adapts to exploit monster vulnerabilities. When you expend a charge to apply a coating on a hit, you can choose to apply an Element Coating.

customFeatures.name: Acid Coating
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d6 Acid damage

customFeatures.name: Cold Coating
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d6 Cold damage

customFeatures.name: Fire Coating
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d6 Fire damage

customFeatures.name: Lightning Coating
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d6 Lightning damage

customFeatures.name: Dragonpiercer
customFeatures.description: As an Action, you plant your feet and fire a penetrating shot. You fire an arrow in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses on a Long Rest.

customFeatures.name: Gauge Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: The quiver can now hold up to 7 Coating Charges.

customFeatures.name: Advanced Coatings
customFeatures.description: You unlock devastating alchemical mixtures.

customFeatures.name: Blast Coating (Cost: 1 Charge)
customFeatures.description: The attack deals its normal damage, and every creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving or take 1d8 Fire damage.

customFeatures.name: Poison Coating (Cost: 2 Charges)
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d4 Poison Damage and the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

customFeatures.name: Paralysis Coating (Cost: 2 Charges)
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 1d4 Lightning damage and the target is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn. Once a creature succeeds on this save, it is immune to your Paralysis Coating for 24 hours.

customFeatures.name: Sleep Coating (Cost: 2 Charges)
customFeatures.description: The target falls Unconscious for 1 minute, or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake.

customFeatures.name: Power Coating Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: When you use your Power Shot Coating, you can now expend up to 2 Coating Charges at once. You roll one additional weapon damage die (1d6) for each charge expended this way, allowing for massive bursts of physical damage.

customFeatures.name: Gauge Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: The quiver can now hold up to 9 Coating Charges.

customFeatures.name: Power Coating Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: You can now expend up to 3 Coating Charges at once.

customFeatures.name: Elemental Coatings Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: Elemental dice damage increases to 2d6.

customFeatures.name: True Dragonpiercer
customFeatures.description: Your Dragonpiercer damage increases to 6d6. Additionally, the shot is so powerful it ignores half and three-quarters cover.

customFeatures.name: Gauge Upgrade III
customFeatures.description: The quiver can now hold up to 12 Coating Charges.
